# Vinayak Bhadani

> Demand planning and supply chain operator in Dubai who also builds and deploys
> agentic AI systems. Currently Demand Planning Executive at Emirates Pride Perfumes.

## What I do
- Demand planning, S&OP, inventory and replenishment across UAE retail and GCC distribution
- Agentic AI engineering: multi-agent systems, RAG, knowledge graphs, deployment on live data
- 14+ free interactive supply chain tools, no signup

## Flagship AI work
- [AlphaOS](https://vinayak682.github.io/alphaos/): agentic multi-market trading platform.
  Four research agents on Supabase Edge Functions, AI signal pipeline, client-side
  backtesting engine, portfolio backtester. Notable for publishing its own negative
  result: walk-forward testing showed the strategies do NOT beat buy-and-hold
  out-of-sample (in-sample +0.27 Sharpe, out-of-sample -0.10, replicated on crypto
  at +0.09 -> -0.21). Drawdown reduction of roughly half did hold across every
  variant and both asset classes.
- [AI Supply Chain Copilot](https://vinayakbhadani.com/ai-supply-chain-copilot.html)
